name: Jump With Justin
author: Addicting Games
description: Jump with Justin is an endless jumping game where your goal is to get Justin up as high as you can! Justin is an eager beaver whose dream has always been to fly. Help Justin reach his lifelong goal by launching him up deep into the lively forest. Navigate his flight by avoiding obstacles while aiming him towards coins and boosts. Use your coins to buy upgrades like coin magnets, rockets, propellers, and balloons to help Justin get higher each time. To track your progress, check the upper tab to see your current and highest score along with your wealth. Head over to the leaderboard to see how you stack up against other players. Try to buy all the upgrades and play this online game repetitively beating your own beaver-launching score each time.
